unit.title: Growing Up and Staying Healthy
unit.blurb: Animals, including humans, have young that grow into adults. Food, exercise, sleep and washing keep us healthy.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Know that animals have young that grow into adults and match young to adults.

O2.t: Know what humans need to stay healthy.

p: Animals have **young**. The young grow into **adults**. A puppy grows into a dog. A baby grows into a child, then a teenager, then an adult.
A **tadpole** does not look like a frog at first. It grows legs, loses its tail and becomes a frog. A caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

A chick grows into a hen.

q.prompt: What does a tadpole grow into?

options.fb: Snakes hatch from eggs as small snakes.
A tadpole looks a bit like a fish but becomes a frog.

p: To stay healthy we need to **eat** different kinds of food, **drink water**, **exercise**, **sleep** and keep **clean**.
Wash your hands with soap before you eat and after the toilet. It washes away germs that can make you ill.

q.prompt: Which drink is best for you every day?

options.fb: Fizzy drinks have lots of sugar.

q.prompt: Why do we wash our hands before eating?

options.fb: It is about germs, not warmth.
Water alone is not the point – soap removes germs.
